posts.title: Creating a DAW in Rust - Chapter 6 - Testing
posts.description: One of the most critical parts of creating production software is testing. It’s one of the best ways to immediately and consistently validate the code - usually before a build so you don’t ship a broken app. In audio apps this becomes even more crucial as you can imagine. With how much low level DSP math is happening, you need ways to verify there isn’t bad math somewhere ruining the sound output.

posts.title: Creating a DAW in Rust - VST Plugins
posts.description: I’ve been tinkering away at a DAW in Rust and Tauri. Most recently I’ve added a multi-track timeline and MIDI support. So I figured, after MIDI, what else is essential for a producer? Plugins.

posts.title: Creating a DAW in Rust - Export Audio
posts.description: In a DAW, audio playback is essential, but what else is just as critical? Exporting audio. What’s the point of composing audio without a way to pull it outside of the app for other people to listen?
